audience: nonprofit fundraisers and development staff who manage donors in Little Green Light

useCases.title: Look up a donor and their giving history
useCases.text: The AI searches constituents by name, email or other terms, opens one record, and lists every gift with amount, date, fund, campaign and appeal.

useCases.title: Find gifts received in a period
useCases.text: The AI searches gifts by date range, amount, fund or campaign and shows who gave what. It sums up the total.

useCases.title: Check if a member is current or lapsed
useCases.text: The AI reads a constituent's memberships with level, start date and finish date, so you can see if the membership is current.

useCases.title: Prepare for a donor meeting
useCases.text: The AI reads a constituent's notes and contact reports (calls, emails, meetings) and sums up the history of contact with them.

useCases.title: Record a gift or log a contact report
useCases.text: The AI records a gift that already happened on a constituent, or logs a call, email or meeting as a contact report. It does not charge a card.
